entries.claim: SEBI FY26 retail F&O data: 78.6 lakh individual traders, net losses Rs 91,685 cr, avg loss Rs 1,16,654; 87.7% of traders lost; F&O STT collections Rs 27,695 cr (FY26)

Budget 2026 removed the capital-gains exemption on SGBs purchased from the secondary market (effective 1 Apr 2026); only original subscribers holding to maturity retain the tax-free redemption; no new SGB tranches in FY 2026-27

FY 2026-27 LRS TCS structure (Finance Act 2026, eff. 1 Apr 2026): loan-funded education 0%; self-funded education/medical 2% above Rs 10L; overseas tour packages 2% flat (no threshold); other LRS purposes 20% above Rs 10L; LRS limit USD 250,000/FY unchanged

IRDAI 2025-26 health-insurance reforms: PED waiting capped at 3 years; entry-age limit removed; moratorium period cut from 8 years to 5 (60 months, Feb 2026) - post-60-month repudiation only on proven fraud
DICGC deposit-insurance limit is ₹5 lakh per depositor, per bank, per same right & capacity (unchanged since the 2015 limit revision; joint accounts: ₹5L per joint holder)
FD rates Aug–Oct 2026: major banks 1-yr ~6.25–7.10% (SBI 6.25%, 444-day Amrit Vrishti 6.45%); small-finance banks up to 8.5% senior / 8.25% general; SFB per-depositor liability cap ₹25L
RBI phased weekly credit-bureau reporting: framework w.e.f. 1 Apr 2026, lenders to file borrower data 4×/month (9th/16th/23rd/last day) from 1 Jul 2026, replacing monthly/fortnightly cycles
ESOP/RSU two-stage taxation (Sec 17(2)(vi) perquisite at exercise + capital gain at sale) unchanged in the IT Act 2025; listed-equity CG FY 2026-27: LTCG 12.5% after 12 months, STCG 20%

Gifts > ₹50,000 in a year from a non-relative (or outside the Sec 57(xii) 'relative' list) are taxable to the recipient at slab rates; gifts from the specified relative list and on marriage are exempt

Unabsorbed capital losses carry forward 8 assessment years under Sec 70(3) only if the ITR for the loss year is filed by the Sec 139(1) due date; STCL is flexible (STCG+LTCG), LTCL is LTCG-only; speculation losses do not carry under 70(3)

Sec 87A rebate makes total tax zero when total taxable income ≤ ₹12 lakh (FY 2026-27 new regime; unchanged from the Budget 2025 reset) — harvesting a capital loss in a below-threshold year has no in-year value
Home-loan interest deduction under Sec 24(b): up to ₹2L p.a. for self-occupied property; new-regime slabs FY 2026-27 unchanged from the Budget 2025 reset
